viewed_photos: Sphagnum microscopic stem - Ohio Moss Lichen
findings: Dense low hummocks retain irregular terminal surface and edges, 12-23 cm. Radiating capitula merge at 25 mm; microscopic stem photo is provenance only. Actually compared reference photographs, current seeds 1, 4, 7 and all 36 seeded variants. Accepted as coarse colony-scale spring geometry, not close-up botanical microdetail. Variant endorsement remains a user decision.
